description: Step-by-step instructions for a build or edit task in Braze, Klaviyo or Iterable, in that platform's own terms, from a procedure library verified against the vendors' docs (with links). Filled in with the team's house rules (naming, sender, UTMs, fallback syntax, footer, channel limits) and, when a snapshot exists, the account: segments and blocks to reuse, whether the target is live, and shared content that would change other live programs. The plugin never edits the account; a person follows the steps. Tasks: create-campaign (Create a one-off or scheduled campaign); create-journey (Create a multi-step journey); edit-live-journey (Change a journey that's already live); edit-live-message (Change the copy of a live or scheduled message); edit-shared-content (Change a shared content block / snippet used in live messages); change-audience (Change who a campaign or journey targets, or add exclusions); link-tracking (Add UTM parameters and click tracking); frequency-and-quiet-hours (Set frequency caps, rate limits and quiet hours); conversion-tracking (Set the conversion event / metric); ab-test (Run an A/B or multivariate test); test-and-preview (Preview as a user and send tests); pause-stop-duplicate (Pause, stop or duplicate).

attributes.description: Personalization attributes the copy will use.

audience.description: Who it's for, in plain words, to find segments to reuse.

target.description: Existing campaign or journey being changed (edit tasks).

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.
